Slice Mean-Pooling.Finding: Fails because focal tears occupy 1-2 slices out of 16; averaging dilutes the lesion signal.

Attention-Only (No LSTM).Finding: Learns slice importance weights, improving over naive mean-pooling.

Slice Max-Pooling (Baseline).Finding: Isolates maximum slice activation feature map.

BiLSTM + Attention (Proposed).Finding: Captures 3D spatial slice sequence continuity across anatomical planes.
